Package com.github.gumtreediff.gen.jdt.cd

Enum Class EntityType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<EntityType>
com.github.gumtreediff.gen.jdt.cd.EntityType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<EntityType>, Constable
public enum EntityType extends Enum<EntityType>
All types for source code entities that are used by ChangeDistiller to build up the AST (abstract syntax tree). Most are taken from ASTNode.
